Vòng hash: bên trái không có virtual nod: The hash ring: on the left there are no virtual nodes so the arcs are badly uneven, on the right each node has many virtual nodes so the load is far more even
Vòng hash — và vì sao virtual node là bắ: The hash ring — and why virtual nodes are mandatory, not an extra optimisation
1 điểm mỗi node — cung rất lệch: 1 point per node — the arcs are badly uneven
Nhiều virtual node mỗi node — cung xen k: Many virtual nodes per node — the arcs interleave
mỗi node có nhiều cung nhỏ rải khắp vòng: each node has many small arcs spread around the ring
⇒ tổng cung của mỗi node xấp xỉ bằng nha: ⇒ every node's total arc is approximately equal
Không có virtual node, consistent hashin: Without virtual nodes, consistent hashing still skews the load badly — which is why every real implementation uses them.
Virtual node cũng là cách xử lý node có: Virtual nodes are also how you handle nodes of differing capacity: give a node that is twice as powerful twice as many vnodes.
